archimate:Outcome.name: Improved Collection Performance (coverage, compliance, reduced leakage) Reported Routinely
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
This outcome tracks the effectiveness of revenue collection through metrics like increased coverage, higher compliance rates, and a measurable reduction in financial leakage. It involves the routine reporting of financial performance against established collection targets.
The intent is to safeguard the integrity of the health fund by ensuring that all due contributions are collected and accounted for. Improved performance provides the financial headroom needed to expand benefit packages and improve service quality.
Example: An automated audit report showing a 15% increase in premium compliance after implementing digital payment reminders.
